items.title: In the Studio With Rama Duwaji
items.summary: 德州出生的叙利亚裔美国艺术家Rama Duwaji在工作室受访,谈插画、动画、油画与陶艺创作。她因丈夫当选纽约市长成为纽约“第一夫人”,讲述辗转德州、迪拜、卡塔尔等地的成长如何塑造其艺术视角,并表示将继续以责任感投入创作。

items.summary_en: Texas-born Syrian-American artist Rama Duwaji discusses her work in illustration, animation, oil painting, and ceramics in a studio interview. As New York's 'First Lady' following her husband's election as mayor, she recounts how growing up across Texas, Dubai, and Qatar shaped her artistic perspective, and expresses her commitment to creating with a sense of responsibility.

items.title: Beer With a Painter: Tom Burckhardt
items.summary: 抽象画家Tom Burckhardt在纽约东村与陶艺家妻子Kathy Butterly共用的工作室接受“与画家喝一杯”专访。他1964年生于艺术家家庭,成长于纽约画派传统中,访谈谈及以怀疑与幽默对抗归类,作品横跨抽象绘画、装置与旧书页拼贴。

items.summary_en: Abstract painter Tom Burckhardt is interviewed for 'Beer With a Painter' in his shared studio in New York's East Village with his wife, ceramicist Kathy Butterly. Born in 1964 into an artistic family and raised in the New York School tradition, he discusses using skepticism and humor to resist categorization, with a practice spanning abstract painting, installation, and collage on old book pages.

items.title: 李明谈最新个展“Swayy Wayy”
items.summary: 艺术家李明就其在香港天线空间的个展“Swayy Wayy”(展至8月8日)接受采访。他谈及如何通过剪辑将密集素材转化为雕塑般的影像,视剪辑为“打碎线性的时间”,介绍自2017年起的“烟士披里纯”系列及对AI的探索,并回顾二十年影像创作。

items.summary_en: Artist Li Ming is interviewed about his solo exhibition 'Swayy Wayy' at Antenna Space in Hong Kong (through August 8). He discusses how editing transforms dense material into sculptural video, viewing editing as 'shattering linear time,' introduces the 'Inspiration' series begun in 2017 and his exploration of AI, and reflects on two decades of video creation.

items.title: 程新皓谈“如此,我们将毫无阻碍地穿越他们的群山”
items.summary: 艺术家程新皓就北京个展接受采访,谈及以踢石头等缓慢身体动作为方法,考察云南如何被历代交通系统塑造。主要作品《层积与漂砾》(2023-2024)记录从昆明到瑞丽沿滇缅公路的行走,呈现多重路网叠合的历史层理与身体感知。

items.summary_en: Artist Cheng Xinhao is interviewed about his Beijing solo exhibition, discussing how slow bodily actions like kicking stones serve as a method to examine how Yunnan has been shaped by successive transportation systems. The main work 'Stratification and Erratic Boulders' (2023-2024) documents a walk from Kunming to Ruili along the Burma Road, revealing historical layers of overlapping road networks and bodily perception.

items.summary: 加拿大艺术家Chloe Wise谈其在巴塞尔H. Geiger文化基金会的首个瑞士机构个展“Extrasensory”。展览从她标志性的具象绘画转向多频影像与沉浸式装置,探讨超感官知觉。她融合科幻、宗教、消费品与艺术史等参照,并称指挥70人团队如同“用人来作画”。

items.summary_en: Canadian artist Chloe Wise discusses her first Swiss institutional solo exhibition 'Extrasensory' at the H. Geiger Cultural Foundation in Basel. The show shifts from her signature figurative painting to multi-channel video and immersive installations exploring extrasensory perception. She blends references from sci-fi, religion, consumer goods, and art history, and describes directing a 70-person team as 'painting with people.'

items.summary_en: Editor's note for the May 2026 issue of Artforum, co-written by Daniel Wenger and Rachel Wetzler. The article reframes "Does criticism matter?" as "What can criticism tell us about the world?", proposing three propositions: "art as form," "art beyond art," and "art reveals lies." Using the "MONUMENTS" exhibition of retired Confederate statues as an example, it emphasizes that criticism is an act that sustains the public sphere as public.

items.summary_en: Aruna D'Souza reviews the 2026 Whitney Biennial (curated by Marcela Guerrero and Drew Sawyer). This edition has no strong theme, using "relations and infrastructure, entanglement and kinship" as threads, including 56 artists from regions affected by the US such as Afghanistan, Chile, Iraq, Okinawa, the Philippines, Puerto Rico, and Vietnam, addressing issues of surveillance, colonialism, mourning, and the environment. Political implications flow through artistic expression rather than providing direct answers.

It selects 30 exhibitions, covering institutions such as Tai Kwun Contemporary, West Bund Museum, and M+, featuring artists like Yang Fudong, Liu Xiaodong, and Lin Tianmiao.

items.summary_en: A review of the 61st Venice Biennale's main exhibition "In Minor Keys". Originally conceived by curator Koyo Kouoh, who passed away in 2025, the exhibition was completed by a five-person team, featuring about 110 artists across the Central Pavilion and the Arsenale. It uses "sentry" figures to connect themes of historical trauma and transcendence. The review gives three and a half stars, noting that the Central Pavilion's layout lacks rhythm, while the Arsenale section has more dramatic tension.

items.summary_zh: 第61届威尼斯国际艺术双年展中国馆5月8日在意大利开幕，主题"梦溪"取自北宋沈括《梦溪笔谈》，以"种子-光-共生"为脉络，呈现书法、影像、数字叙事等多种形式作品，含"致敬《梦溪笔谈》""良渚之光""逍遥游"等。展览由文化和旅游部主办，持续至11月22日。
items.summary_en: The China Pavilion of the 61st Venice International Art Biennale opened on May 8 in Italy, with the theme "Dream Creek" taken from Shen Kuo's "Dream Pool Essays" of the Northern Song Dynasty. Following the thread of "Seed-Light-Symbiosis," it presents works in various forms including calligraphy, video, and digital narrative, featuring sections such as "Homage to Dream Pool Essays," "Light of Liangzhu," and "Wandering Beyond." The exhibition is hosted by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism and runs until November 22.

The exhibition has no official theme; 56 artists and collectives explore "American identity" and the impact of the American empire, covering interspecies connections, complicating history (colonialism in Hawaii, Marcos regime in the Philippines, AIDS epidemic, etc.), cities and systems, looking and being looked at, and family matters. The exhibition is held on the fifth and sixth floors of the Whitney Museum.

items.summary: 《艺术新闻报》报道,艺术家Refik Anadol打造的'全球首座AI艺术博物馆'DATALAND于2026年6月20日在洛杉矶Grand LA开幕。观众佩戴监测心跳的腕带与释放香气的颈环;开幕展《Machine Dreams: Rainforest》用'大自然大模型'生成沉浸式雨林影像,并随观众反馈变化。

items.summary_zh: 《艺术新闻报》报道，艺术家Refik Anadol打造的'全球首座AI艺术博物馆'DATALAND于2026年6月20日在洛杉矶Grand LA开幕。观众佩戴监测心跳的腕带与释放香气的颈环；开幕展《Machine Dreams: Rainforest》用'大自然大模型'生成沉浸式雨林影像，并随观众反馈变化。
items.summary_en: The Art Newspaper reports that DATALAND, the 'world's first AI art museum' created by artist Refik Anadol, opened on June 20, 2026, at Grand LA in Los Angeles. Visitors wear wristbands that monitor heartbeats and necklaces that release scents; the opening exhibition "Machine Dreams: Rainforest" uses a 'large nature model' to generate immersive rainforest imagery that changes with audience feedback.

items.title: Avery Singer: War_overlays（苏黎世豪瑟沃斯个展）
items.source: Meer(艺术线上杂志) / Hauser & Wirth
items.summary: 艺术杂志Meer介绍Avery Singer在苏黎世豪瑟沃斯画廊的个展《War_overlays》(2026年6月12日-9月5日)。她首次将AI工具引入绘画,用ComfyUI训练定制LoRA生成'AI渣画质'图像;作品受鲍德里亚海湾战争论述启发,反思西方冲突如何作为媒体奇观被呈现。

items.summary_zh: 艺术杂志Meer介绍Avery Singer在苏黎世豪瑟沃斯画廊的个展《War_overlays》（2026年6月12日-9月5日）。她首次将AI工具引入绘画，用ComfyUI训练定制LoRA生成'AI渣画质'图像；作品受鲍德里亚海湾战争论述启发，反思西方冲突如何作为媒体奇观被呈现。
items.summary_en: Art magazine Meer introduces Avery Singer's solo exhibition "War_overlays" at Hauser & Wirth Zurich (June 12 - September 5, 2026). She introduces AI tools into painting for the first time, training custom LoRAs with ComfyUI to generate 'AI low-quality' images; the works are inspired by Baudrillard's discourse on the Gulf War, reflecting on how Western conflicts are presented as media spectacles.
